'''Giorgos Catsadorakis''' is a Greek biologist. He was awarded the [[Goldman Environmental Prize]] in 2001, for his contributions to the protection of the wetlands of [[Lake Prespa|Préspa]], jointly with fellow biologist [[Myrsini Malakou]]. Their efforts resulted in an agreement between Greece, the Republic of Macedonia and Albania on establishing the Préspa Park as a protected area of the region.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.goldmanprize.org/node/90|title=Europe 2001. Giorgos Catsadorakis & Myrsini Malakou. Greece. Land Preservation|publisher=[[Goldman Environmental Prize]]|accessdate=21 November 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101123042728/http://goldmanprize.org/node/90|archive-date=23 November 2010|url-status=dead}}</ref>
